Nepal Floods Leave Hundreds Missing, Rescue Efforts Underway

Flash floods in Nepal, triggered by heavy rains and landslides, have resulted in hundreds of people missing and widespread destruction. In Tibet's Saga, 37 Maharashtra pilgrims were stranded but have reached Kathmandu. The death toll has crossed 800, with some reports indicating over 900 missing from hydropower projects. Rescue operations are ongoing, with authorities working to reach survivors and locate the missing. Several state governments in India have reported citizens stranded in Nepal and are coordinating efforts for their safety and repatriation.
